findings.text: §28 says a review that follows its run's lane launched on `codex` "without the exclusion applied", and its Deliverable commits to making that route "take the exclusion into account"; but `_ordered_review_lanes` (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:1207-1214) already filters the owning lane through `excluded` before ordering, and `recovery_review_dispatch.py:1862` sets `owning_lane` to the reviewed run's `backend` (codex, excluded), so that route already yields the local lane and already has a test whose docstring says the exclusion is asserted on every axis (`tests/test_review_lane_follows_its_run.py`). Three of the four runs §28 cites are `route_mode: explicit`, a route §28's own Deliverable says is honoured, so its cited evidence does not distinguish a lane that followed the run from a lane a caller named.
